| **Repo** | `box/fedora` |

The Fedora skill carrier: the package candy that OWNS the ten `fedora*` skill
entities (`fedora`, `fedora-builder`, `fedora-nonfree`, `fedora-coder`,
`fedora-test`, `charly-fedora`, `jupyter-ml-notebook`, `sway-browser-vnc`,
`tutorial-shell`, `valkey-test`).  It ships no install content — its payload is
the skill prose under `.agents/skills/`, read at build time by the skill
collector — and it exists because a skill's `owner:` must name a candy that
rides an image, not the image itself (opencharly/sdk#434).  Composed by every
Fedora image that owns one of those skills.

## Acceptance plan

This candy's `plan:` — the runnable spec `charly check` executes against a live deployment. `check:` steps are idempotent probes; `run:` steps change state.

| Intent | Step |
|---|---|
| `run` | this skill-carrier candy ships no install content |
| `check` | this carrier registers as a candy and ships no install content — its skill bodies are validated at build-config time by `charly box validate`, not inside the image |
